evd_title: GPT-4 achieved 61% raw percent agreement with Cochrane reviewers on ROBINS-I overall risk of bias with Kendall coefficient of 0.35
finding: GPT-4 achieved 61% raw percent agreement with Cochrane reviewers on ROBINS-I overall risk of bias with Kendall coefficient of 0.35
P: 307 non-randomised studies from 36 Cochrane systematic reviews (medicine) with ROBINS-I assessments
I: GPT-4 via ChatGPT Plus, zero-shot; Methods + Results copy-pasted from Word-converted text
O: Overall RoB: raw agreement 61%, weighted kappa 0.13, Kendall tau 0.35; domains 31-71% raw, kappa 0.02-0.28
T: GPT-4 accessed Aug 2023; Cochrane SRs citing ROBINS-I (dates not reported); paper 2024
